title: PR 3d — bills surfaces: web Bills page, mobile Capture "Pay later", chat record/pay/query, bank match to a bill

goals.text: Web Bills page: Open (open+partial, overdue included) / Overdue / Paid filters, aging buckets read from reports/ap-aging, still-owing per bill; add (one idempotency key in header + body), edit as PATCH amend for posted at_entry bills and PUT for legacy at_payment bills, pay in full (no amount), pay part (amountCents; over-owing refused before any request), void (409 bill_has_payments explained), payment void (DELETE /bills/:id/payments/:pid); en/fr-CA through the real catalog. Mutation-checked on file copies: edit method, Open filter, overpay guard, create key, payment-void URL each fail this file. UMD bundle rebuilt and committed to both cdn paths.

Mobile Capture "Pay later" (manual business entry; switch role + due date defaulting to bill date + 14): online → createBill in _lib/api.ts (POST /bills, key in Idempotency-Key header and body, never an expense); offline or a lost response → queueBill with the SAME key, replayed to /bills by the page and by sw.js; vendor and due ≥ bill date required; POST /bills replays the key for at_payment bills too (same key twice → one bill, 200) and resolves Capture's categoryId tenant-scoped (another tenant's account → 422). Home bills-due alert covers every open|partial bill in the window: one alert with the count and Σ still owing (partial counts its remainder), copy in en/fr-CA/zh-CN.

Chat skills record-bill, pay-bill, query-payables (before general-question) call the bills routes only (lib/purchases): record posts vendor/amount/due parsed from en/fr-CA/zh-CN text (14-day default stated in the reply); pay pays the named open bill in full or the stated part, refuses over-owing before any write, asks which when ambiguous, and with no open bill + an amount falls back to record-expense (pre-3d behaviour); query totals Σ outstanding of open+partial with aging from reports/ap-aging. manage-bills keeps its manifest (no triggers) and delegates. Routed through the REAL consultation triage and classifier in en/fr-CA/zh-CN, in code, DB (name asc) and prod-unseeded skill order, identically for web/telegram/mcp; definition questions stay with the advisor; record-expense, record-invoice-payment and aging-report no longer steal bill turns (mutation-checked).

Bank match: the proposal path (matchTransactionWithCandidates) offers unpaid bills for a debit (scoreBillMatch on what is still owing, bill→due window, vendor; ties go to the bill); applyBillMatch records a bill payment through lib/purchases (DR 2000 / CR 1000 for at_entry), capped at what is owing, idempotent on bank:<txnId>, sets matchedBillId and never creates an expense; cross-tenant bills 404 with nothing posted; wired into bank-sync auto-match (review band stores the guess), POST bank-transactions/:id/match {targetType:'bill'} (one tap "this is for bill X"), the candidates route and Telegram; the daily-pulse auto-record skips any debit with a bill candidate. Each wiring mutation-checked.

launch.rollback: Revert the PR. No schema change (AbBankTransaction.matchedBillId and the bill tables shipped in 3a). Bills, payments and journal entries created meanwhile through the new surfaces are ordinary lib/purchases rows and stay valid; bank transactions matched to bills keep matchedBillId (unread after a revert) and their bill payments remain — void a payment from the Bills page if it must be undone. Capture "Pay later" bills still queued offline at revert time replay to /bills, which still exists. The chat skills disappear from routing on revert; manage-bills' triggers come back with it.
